source: Generated from `bench/public/templates.ts`, seed 20261005, 50 prompts per language and format
editsAfterResults: `session={uuid}` in the log templates was relabelled `request_id={uuid}` after the first run, in which the rules masked every such UUID. A session id is a credential, so the alternative was to keep it and label it SECRET.
a bare commit hash after a version and an `etag={sha256}` context were added after the first run; they added rules false positives.

english.name: rules + name model (experimental)
english.note: rules + name model (experimental): the proxy-default rules plus the nym name model (`rules-6+intl-2+ext-1+nym-edge-int8-2`, shipped `nameModel` defaults), through the code path the proxy uses for user-written text. Each prompt is one user message; the model reads only its prose lines and skips code, log, config, and data lines by design, so it cannot find names there except by propagation of a value found in prose. Sensitive values inside prose lines, by format: chat 100%, code 0%, log 60%, config 0%, email 100%, stacktrace 0%. Its latency includes inference

english.name: Presidio 2.2.364 (en_core_web_lg, cutoff 0)
english.note: Presidio: presidio-analyzer 2.2.364, spaCy 3.8.16, en_core_web_lg 3.8.0, the default model; default recognizers; language "en" for every prompt; the cutoff is Presidio's `score_threshold`, below which detections are dropped; latency is analysis only
